artifacts.purpose: Pure dependency-readiness derivation plus repository scanner/CLI. Produces a projection only; never edits queue authority.
Falsification suite for RETURN+DONE semantics, missing terminal evidence, failure/conflict, cycles, authority, activation rules and source preservation.

proved_behaviors: matching qualifying RETURN + DONE for the same opportunity/run is required for dependency satisfaction
ALL_DEPENDENCIES_HAVE_RETURN becomes READY_DERIVED only when every dependency has exact terminal evidence
conflicted durable prerequisite evidence stays blocked even when another attempt appears successful
dependency cycles remain blocked and are not broken by arbitrary edge deletion
authority block takes precedence over dependency satisfaction and priority
ANY_MAJOR_INTEGRATION_RETURN activates only from at least one proven RETURN+DONE pair
existing READY source lanes are preserved and the queue input is not mutated
repository scanner recursively reads standard runs/returns and emits queue SHA-256 source receipts
known_boundary: This worker implemented and exercised the derivation mechanism as a canary. It did not edit source queue statuses, self-promote /w, or claim that later dependency transitions have already occurred.
